description: Buy or extend a house plan for 1-12 months: room now (house 1 GB is coming later and returns plan_coming_later). pay_with=credits spends earned credits immediately. pay_with=usdc returns an invoice with a unique exact USDC amount and pay_to on Base plus an invoice_secret (shown once); send that exact amount, then call verify_usdc_payment and the plan is applied automatically. pay_with=anansi returns anansi_checkout_off. Upgrades count unused days of your current plan.
